scripts.dev: doppler run -p dorks -c dev -- pnpm --parallel --filter @dorks/convex --filter @dorks/web dev
scripts.dev:sim: doppler run -p dorks -c dev -- env CONVEX_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3210 node infra/bridge-sim/host.mjs
scripts.dev:convex: doppler run -p dorks -c dev -- pnpm --filter @dorks/convex dev
scripts.dev:web: doppler run -p dorks -c dev -- pnpm --filter @dorks/web dev
scripts.dev:ios: doppler run -p dorks -c dev -- pnpm --filter @dorks/ios start
scripts.stripe:setup: doppler run -p dorks -c dev -- node apps/convex/scripts/stripe-setup.mjs --write-doppler dev
scripts.byok:e2e: doppler run -p dorks -c dev -- pnpm --filter @dorks/convex exec node scripts/byok-e2e.mjs
scripts.billing:e2e: doppler run -p dorks -c dev -- pnpm --filter @dorks/convex exec node scripts/billing-e2e.mjs
scripts.push:convex-env: doppler run -p dorks -c prd -- pnpm --filter @dorks/convex sync-env
